mapper.sql: R.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID AS roomId, R.UNIV_ID AS univId, U.UNIV_NAME AS univName, R.TITLE AS title, R.CATEGORY AS category, CASE WHEN R.STATUS = 'PROGRESS' THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' ELSE R.STATUS END AS status, TO_CHAR(R.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt, COALESCE( ( SELECT TO_CHAR(M.SEND_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') FROM INQUIRY_MESSAGES M WHERE M.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID = R.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID ORDER BY M.SEND_TIME DESC, M.INQUIRY_MESSAGE_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ), TO_CHAR(R.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') ) AS lastAt, COALESCE( ( SELECT DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(M.INQUIRY_MESSAGE_CONTENT, 1000, 1) FROM INQUIRY_MESSAGES M WHERE M.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID = R.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID ORDER BY M.SEND_TIME DESC, M.INQUIRY_MESSAGE_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ), '' ) AS lastMessage, ( SELECT MIN(P.MEMBER_ID) FROM INQUIRY_PARTICIPANT P JOIN MEMBER PM ON PM.MEMBER_ID = P.MEMBER_ID WHERE P.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID = R.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID AND PM.ROLE = 'ADM' ) AS adminMemberId, ( SELECT MIN(PM.MEMBER_NAME) FROM INQUIRY_PARTICIPANT P JOIN MEMBER PM ON PM.MEMBER_ID = P.MEMBER_ID WHERE P.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID = R.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID AND PM.ROLE = 'ADM' ) AS adminName, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INQUIRY_MESSAGES UM WHERE UM.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID = R.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID AND (#{memberId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL OR UM.MEMBER_ID != #{memberId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}) AND NVL(UM.STATUS, 0) = 0 ) AS unreadCount
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_INQUIRY_ROOMS.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO INQUIRY_ROOMS ( INQUIRY_ROOM_ID, UNIV_ID, TITLE, CATEGORY, CREATED_AT, STATUS ) VALUES ( #{roomId}, #{univId}, #{title}, #{category}, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{status} )

MERGE INTO INQUIRY_PARTICIPANT P USING ( SELECT #{roomId} AS INQUIRY_ROOM_ID, #{memberId} AS MEMBER_ID FROM DUAL ) SRC ON ( P.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID = SRC.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID AND P.MEMBER_ID = SRC.MEMBER_ID ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( MEMBER_ID, INQUIRY_ROOM_ID ) VALUES ( SRC.MEMBER_ID, SRC.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM INQUIRY_ROOMS R JOIN UNIVERSITY U ON U.UNIV_ID = R.UNIV_ID WHERE R.UNIV_ID = #{univId} ORDER BY lastAt DESC, R.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID DESC

SELECT
FROM INQUIRY_ROOMS R JOIN UNIVERSITY U ON U.UNIV_ID = R.UNIV_ID ORDER BY lastAt DESC, R.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID DESC

SELECT
FROM INQUIRY_ROOMS R JOIN UNIVERSITY U ON U.UNIV_ID = R.UNIV_ID WHERE R.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID = #{roomId}

SELECT M.INQUIRY_MESSAGE_ID AS messageId, M.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID AS roomId, M.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, MB.MEMBER_NAME AS senderName, MB.ROLE AS senderRole, M.INQUIRY_MESSAGE_CONTENT AS content, TO_CHAR(M.SEND_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS sentAt, CASE WHEN NVL(M.STATUS, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS read FROM INQUIRY_MESSAGES M JOIN MEMBER MB ON MB.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID WHERE M.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY M.SEND_TIME ASC, M.INQUIRY_MESSAGE_ID ASC

SELECT M.INQUIRY_MESSAGE_ID AS messageId, M.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID AS roomId, M.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, MB.MEMBER_NAME AS senderName, MB.ROLE AS senderRole, M.INQUIRY_MESSAGE_CONTENT AS content, TO_CHAR(M.SEND_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS sentAt, CASE WHEN NVL(M.STATUS, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS read FROM INQUIRY_MESSAGES M JOIN MEMBER MB ON MB.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID WHERE M.INQUIRY_MESSAGE_ID = #{messageId}

SELECT SEQ_INQUIRY_MESSAGES.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO INQUIRY_MESSAGES ( INQUIRY_MESSAGE_ID, INQUIRY_ROOM_ID, MEMBER_ID, INQUIRY_MESSAGE_CONTENT, SEND_TIME, STATUS ) VALUES ( #{messageId}, #{roomId}, #{memberId}, #{content}, SYSTIMESTAMP, 0 )

SELECT SEQ_INQUIRY_ATTACHMENTS.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO INQUIRY_ATTACHMENTS ( ATTACHMENT_ID, INQUIRY_MESSAGE_ID, ORIGINAL_NAME, SAVE_NAME, FILE_PATH, FILE_SIZE, FILE_TYPE, CREATE_AT ) VALUES ( #{attachmentId}, #{messageId}, #{originalName}, #{saveName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT ATTACHMENT_ID AS attachmentId, INQUIRY_MESSAGE_ID AS messageId, ORIGINAL_NAME AS originalName, SAVE_NAME AS saveName, FILE_PATH AS filePath, FILE_SIZE AS fileSize, FILE_TYPE AS fileType, TO_CHAR(CREATE_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt FROM INQUIRY_ATTACHMENTS WHERE INQUIRY_MESSAGE_ID = #{messageId} ORDER BY ATTACHMENT_ID ASC

SELECT ATTACHMENT_ID AS attachmentId, INQUIRY_MESSAGE_ID AS messageId, ORIGINAL_NAME AS originalName, SAVE_NAME AS saveName, FILE_PATH AS filePath, FILE_SIZE AS fileSize, FILE_TYPE AS fileType, TO_CHAR(CREATE_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt FROM INQUIRY_ATTACHMENTS WHERE ATTACHMENT_ID = #{attachmentId}
